newsitem.title: USA: Panel finds Spaghetti not liable in case.
newsitem.headline: Panel finds Spaghetti not liable in case.

text.p: Spaghetti Warehouse Inc said Thursday an arbitration planel had not found it to be liable in a case involving claims made by Bright-Kaplan International Corp.

The company, which operates a chain of Italian restaurants, said the American Arbitration Association did find that it had brought Bright-Kaplan into a franchise agreement by misrepresenting and concealing information.
Bright-Kaplan had accused Spaghetti of also failing to give it services in support of its franchise, engaging in deceptive trade practices and violating federal disclosure rules.
It had been seeking more than $9 million in damages.
